source_evidence.adapter: services/source_ingestion/connectors/finmind_taiwan.py: FinMindTaiwanKBarAdapter, FinMindLiveFetcher.fetch_kbar, fetch_kbar (budgeted), KBarHourlyBudget (4500/h, 402 stops until next hour, no retry), compute_bar_availability_ts, classify_range_probe, measure_volume_unit, observe_publication_time
source_evidence.pit_contract: normalized row carries provider_published_at (only if supplied, never invented), fetched_at, reconciled_at, bar_availability_ts = max(bar_end, fetched_at, reconciled_at), None (pending_reconciliation) until reconciled; raw row, request id, source hash and quota_meta (request_url stripped) are kept per record
source_evidence.session_rules: bars kept for 09:00..13:30 Asia/Taipei start; others dropped and counted; conflicting duplicate minute -> reported for day quarantine; non-trading day rejected via injected is_trading_day
source_evidence.out_of_list_edit: services/source_ingestion/provider_adapters.py: registered FinMindTaiwanKBarAdapter token + _finmind_kbar handler. Required because ConnectorDefinition rejects adapter tokens missing from the provider allowlist (module import fails otherwise). No behaviour change for other adapters.
source_evidence.production_path: provider_adapters._finmind_kbar: when request has no caller payload it performs a real FinMindLiveFetcher.fetch_kbar via fetch_kbar() with the process-wide shared KBarHourlyBudget (4500/h); missing credential -> FinMindCredentialError with zero network; budget exhausted / 402 -> SourceEvidenceError (stop, no retry in window). fetched_at comes from the real response. Caller-supplied payload still accepted for replay.
